title: Number of satisfying assignments
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ Boolean coordinates, with distinct coordinates in its literals, and let $\operatorname{width}(T)$ be its number of literals. The number of sign assignments in $\{-1,1\}^n$ on which every literal of $T$ is true is $2^{n-\operatorname{width}(T)}$.
hypotheses_covered: A term on $n$ coordinates with pairwise distinct literal coordinates
